results.description: EMQX broker build (make emqx-enterprise-compile: mix deps.get + mix compile) — messaging/copy bound
notes: EMQX builds with Erlang/OTP 28 (env.sh OTP_VSN / .tool-versions), but `erl` on PATH is OTP 29: the umbrella build aborts in a dependency NIF (:ezstd) whose makefile generates env.mk via `erl -noshell -s init stop -eval …`, an idiom OTP 29 no longer evaluates, so `mix compile` fails with "No rule to make target '…/env.mk'"; no number is fabricated
